parameters.content:
### {{CLINIC_NAME}} - Data Archival & Retention Management (PET WF16)

**🎯 Purpose:** Automated data archival system with 5-year retention policy and comprehensive audit trail

**🚀 Key Features:**

**Automated Data Retention:**
• **Monthly Processing:** Runs on the 1st of each month at 2 AM
• **5-Year Retention Policy:** Automatically identifies records older than 5 years
• **Smart Date Detection:** Handles multiple date field formats and structures
• **Safety Protocols:** Comprehensive validation before any data operations
• **Flexible Thresholds:** Configurable retention periods for different data types

**Intelligent Archival Engine:**
• **Multi-Field Date Analysis:** Scans multiple date fields for accurate age calculation
• **Data Validation:** Ensures data integrity before archival operations
• **Batch Processing:** Efficiently handles large datasets with memory optimization
• **Error Handling:** Robust error detection and recovery mechanisms
• **Rollback Capability:** Safe archival with verification at each step

**Comprehensive Audit Trail:**
• **Process Logging:** Complete record of all archival activities
• **Before/After Analysis:** Detailed comparison of data states
• **Performance Metrics:** Processing time and efficiency tracking
• **Error Documentation:** Full error logs with resolution guidance
• **Compliance Reporting:** Audit-ready documentation for regulatory requirements

**⚡ Automated Archival Process:**

**1. Data Discovery & Analysis:**
- **Record Scanning:** Comprehensive scan of all appointment records
- **Date Field Detection:** Intelligent identification of date columns
- **Age Calculation:** Precise calculation of record age using multiple date formats
- **Volume Assessment:** Analysis of archival impact and storage requirements
- **Risk Evaluation:** Assessment of data dependencies and relationships

**2. Archive Preparation:**
- **Data Enhancement:** Addition of archival metadata and tracking information
- **Quality Validation:** Verification of data completeness and integrity
- **Batch Organization:** Optimal grouping of records for efficient processing
- **Backup Creation:** Safety backup before any destructive operations
- **Index Generation:** Creation of searchable archive indexes

**3. Safe Archival Execution:**
- **Archive Sheet Creation:** Automatic creation of dated archive sheets
- **Data Migration:** Secure transfer of records to archive storage
- **Verification Process:** Confirmation of successful archival before cleanup
- **Cleanup Operations:** Safe removal of archived records from active sheets
- **Index Updates:** Maintenance of archive catalogs and search indexes

**4. Reporting & Compliance:**
- **Executive Summary:** High-level archival metrics and status
- **Detailed Breakdown:** Record-by-record archival documentation
- **Compliance Documentation:** Audit trail for regulatory requirements
- **Performance Analytics:** Processing efficiency and optimization opportunities
- **Error Reports:** Comprehensive documentation of any issues encountered

**📊 Data Management Coverage:**

**Appointment Records:**
• Patient appointment history and scheduling data
• Treatment records and medical notes
• Payment and billing information
• Communication logs and follow-up tracking
• Customer service interactions and feedback

**Customer Information:**
• Pet owner contact details and preferences
• Pet medical history and vaccination records
• Insurance information and claim history
• Loyalty program participation and rewards
• Communication preferences and opt-out requests

**Business Intelligence:**
• Historical performance metrics and KPIs
• Seasonal trends and capacity planning data
• Staff performance and scheduling history
• Inventory usage patterns and supplier data
• Financial reconciliation and audit trails

**🔒 Data Security & Compliance:**

**Privacy Protection:**
• Automated PII identification and handling
• Secure archival with encryption standards
• Access control and permission management
• Data anonymization for analytical purposes
• GDPR and HIPAA compliance protocols

**Retention Compliance:**
• Industry-standard 5-year retention policy
• Configurable retention periods by data type
• Legal hold capabilities for litigation support
• Automated compliance reporting and documentation
• Regular compliance audits and verification

**Data Integrity:**
• Checksum verification for archived data
• Regular integrity scans and validation
• Backup and recovery procedures
• Version control and change tracking
• Disaster recovery and business continuity

**📈 Business Benefits:**

**Performance Optimization:**
• Reduced active database size for faster queries
• Improved system performance and response times
• Lower storage costs through intelligent archival
• Enhanced backup and recovery efficiency
• Optimized reporting and analytics performance

**Compliance & Risk Management:**
• Automated regulatory compliance maintenance
• Reduced legal and financial risks
• Professional audit trail documentation
• Standardized data retention policies
• Proactive compliance monitoring and reporting

**Operational Efficiency:**
• Automated data lifecycle management
• Reduced manual data management overhead
• Consistent and reliable archival processes
• Improved data organization and searchability
• Enhanced business intelligence and reporting

**🔄 Integration Points:**
• Active Data: {{MASTER_APPOINTMENTS_SHEET_ID}}
• Archive Storage: {{ARCHIVE_SHEET_ID}}
• Process Logs: {{DATA_MANAGEMENT_LOG_SHEET_ID}}
• Email Notifications: {{BUSINESS_EMAIL}}
• Compliance Reports: Automated monthly distribution

**⚙️ Configuration:**
• Clinic: {{CLINIC_NAME}}
• Schedule: Monthly (1st day, 2 AM)
• Retention Period: 5 years (configurable)
• Timezone: {{TIMEZONE}}
• Archive Format: Enhanced Google Sheets with metadata
• Notification Level: Executive summary + detailed logs
